source: Earthdawn 4E Player's Guide — Combat Options (p.382-385) and the Situation Modifiers Table (p.386-390). Mechanics distilled into structured data; no verbatim rulebook prose. Where the local player-tables-narrative.txt disagreed with the Player's Guide (Called Shot strain; the Attacking to Stun / Attacking to Knockdown split; Physical & Mystic — not P/M/S — defence scope), the Player's Guide is authoritative.
notes: Applied on demand by engine/combat.js when the player selects an option/situation on the Combat tab — never auto-folded into the character's static derived stats. Every effect is therefore condition:"situational" (the engine's auto-apply rule folds only condition:"always" effects into static values), and source:"condition" (the closest §9 provenance for a chosen combat maneuver / situation; combat options are not a §9 source, and adding one would be a taxonomy change).

Strain is a resource-modifier on { domain:"resource", name:"Strain" } (measure:"points") — the option declares its cost; combat.js sums the selected options' strain and applies it to the character as damage via ed-edit-health (Strain has no stored pool). See PLAN-COMBAT-TAB.md A9.

Test bonuses/penalties are test-modifier on test/Attack, test/Damage, or test/Action with measure:"step" (they change the dice Step) — except the Knocked Down Action penalty, which is measure:"result" to match engine/health.js KNOCKED_DOWN_EFFECT.

defense-modifier effects are Physical & Mystic only; Social Defence applies at the gamemaster's discretion (Situation Modifiers Table footnote). In the Combat tab these are informational only (PLAN-COMBAT-TAB.md B7): they are shown as 'derived Defence + toggled mods' and are never dispatched into the always-on derived defence.

note-type entries carry rules that have no machine-applicable taxonomy encoding (Full Cover 'unhittable', Surprised 'no tests allowed', Stun/Knockdown damage subtypes, movement maneuvers) — display-only riders.

excludes lists mutually-exclusive options (Aggressive Attack <-> Defensive Stance, PG p.382). mapsToCondition marks a situation the sheet already tracks (Knocked Down, encumbrance Harried); the tab pre-selects and locks those chips from the model so their effects are not double-counted.

appliesTo scopes an option to the attack types that may use it, using the engine's weapon-category tags (melee, missile, throwing, unarmed). Absent = available to any attack pick. The Combat tab hides a scoped option unless the selected weapon's category — or, for the 'None' weapon, the mapped category of the selected attack talent, e.g. Unarmed Combat → unarmed — is in its list. Source: close-combat options (Aggressive Attack, Attacking to Knockdown/Stun, Shattering a Shield) require a close combat Attack test, PG p.382-385; Setting Against a Charge needs a melee weapon long enough to reach past the mount's fore section, PG p.385.

restricted likewise gates an option to a race: its value is the exact rules/races.json race name (e.g. "T'skrang") and the tab hides the option unless the character's meta.race matches (Tail Attack, PG p.382).

In addition to these global options, a single thread weapon may carry its own item-scoped option bundles (rules/thread-items.json item `combatOptions`, e.g. the custom Orc Stinger's Double Bolt) — same bundle shape, rendered and folded by the Combat tab only while that weapon is selected (docs/THREAD-ITEMS.md §4.1).

options.name: Aggressive Attack
options.summary: +3 to Attack and Damage tests; −3 Physical & Mystic Defence; 1 Strain per attack.

options.name: Attacking to Knockdown
options.summary: Possibly knocks the opponent down; inflicts no real damage.

effects.summary: The attack may knock the opponent down but inflicts no real damage (PG p.383). Resolution is opponent-side; the sheet tracks no opponent, so this is a display-only rider.

options.name: Attacking to Stun
options.summary: The Damage test inflicts Stun damage.

effects.summary: The Damage test inflicts Stun damage — a damage subtype the sheet does not track separately (PG p.383).

options.name: Called Shot
options.summary: −3 to the Attack test; 1 Strain; on success hits a designated area (cannot increase damage).

effects.summary: On success the attack hits the designated area; a Called Shot cannot be used to increase the damage of an attack (PG p.384).

options.name: Defensive Stance
options.summary: +3 Physical & Mystic Defence; −3 to all tests except Knockdown.

effects.summary: −3 to all tests except Knockdown tests.

options.name: Jump Up
options.summary: Knocked-down only: stand as a Simple action (2 Strain); on success stand and take a Standard action.

effects.summary: Usable only while knocked down. Instead of standing as a Standard action, take 2 Strain and make a Dexterity (6) test as a Simple action, modified by any armour Initiative Penalty but not the −3 knocked-down penalty. On success, stand and take a Standard action (no other movement); on failure, still stand using a Standard action (PG p.385). Not part of the attack pool — its 2 Strain is applied when the maneuver is used.
Lets the character unhorse a charging mounted opponent; may be combined with Defensive Stance and Attacking to Knockdown (PG p.385).

options.name: Splitting Movement
options.summary: Move / act / move in one round; 1 Strain; the character becomes Harried.

effects.summary: Split the round's movement around the action (move / act / move); the character is considered Harried for the round (see the Harried situation) (PG p.385).

options.name: Tail Attack
options.summary: t'skrang only: an extra Unarmed Combat attack this round at −2 to all tests.

effects.summary: t'skrang racial ability: make one additional Unarmed Combat attack this round at −2 to all tests. The extra attack is rolled separately, so it is a display-only rider in v1.

situations.name: Blindsided
situations.summary: −2 Physical & Mystic Defence (Social at the gamemaster's discretion).

effects.summary: In certain situations the gamemaster may also apply this −2 to Social Defence (PG p.386).

situations.name: Full Cover
situations.summary: Cannot be targeted — Defence is not applicable.

effects.summary: Full cover completely obscures the character; they cannot be attacked without special abilities or talents, so Defence is not applicable (PG p.387). 'Unhittable' has no machine-applicable taxonomy encoding, so this is a display-only rider.
Blindness / Dazzled are equivalent to darkness. Heat Sight ignores darkness; Low-Light Vision treats full darkness as partial and ignores partial (PG p.388).
Blindness / Dazzled are equivalent to darkness. Heat Sight ignores darkness; Low-Light Vision treats full darkness as partial (PG p.388).

situations.name: Harried
situations.summary: −2 to Action tests; −2 Physical & Mystic Defence.

effects.summary: Social Defence at the gamemaster's discretion. When the sheet already reports the character as Harried (e.g. from encumbrance), the tab pre-selects and locks this chip so its effects are not counted twice.

situations.name: Knocked Down
situations.summary: −3 to Action tests; −3 Physical & Mystic Defence.

effects.summary: −3 to all tests while knocked down.

Mirrors engine/health.js KNOCKED_DOWN_EFFECT (the Action penalty is measure:"result"). The sheet already folds this when the Knocked Down condition is set, so the tab pre-selects and locks this chip from the model to avoid double-counting; the roll-time −3 rides every roll (PLAN-WOUNDS-KNOCKDOWN Option B — no Action-only / Initiative / Knockdown / Recovery exemptions, Karma die only excluded).
−2 to Action tests at long range.

situations.name: Surprised
situations.summary: No actions this round; −3 Physical & Mystic Defence.

effects.summary: A surprised character can take no actions this round and subtracts −3 from Physical & Mystic Defence (Social at the gamemaster's discretion) (PG p.390). 'No tests allowed' has no machine-applicable taxonomy encoding, so the whole situation is a display-only rider.
